messages.content: Please finish the resort comparison now. I need the true four-night totals, what the breakfast credit actually covers, the spa pricing and hold status, and the cancellation and deposit exposure. Also compare renting a car with transfers and rideshares.

I have current terms for all three Scottsdale options. I’ll separate mandatory lodging cost from transportation and spa charges so the comparison is clean. One point first: should I price a rental car as an economy car, or would you want a larger vehicle?
Economy is fine. We will each have one carry-on. Start with the resort totals.

For March 12-16, the Andaz prepaid breakfast package is $1,920.00 total: $1,500 room charge, $216.00 room tax, and $204.00 in resort fees and related tax. The package includes a $60 breakfast credit per room for each of the four mornings, up to $240 total. It applies at the designated restaurant and to breakfast room service food, but not gratuity, alcohol, or unused amounts carried to another day. The entire $1,920 is charged at booking and is nonrefundable and nonchangeable.
So the breakfast credit is not a reduction in the booking total. What is the second property?

Correct. It offsets eligible breakfast spending after check-in. The Hyatt flexible rate is $2,068.04 for lodging: $1,596.00 room, $223.44 room tax, $220.00 resort fee, and $28.60 tax on that fee. The resort fee is mandatory. Cancellation is allowed until 11:59 p.m. Arizona time three days before arrival; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax, currently $454.86. A one-night deposit is charged at booking and becomes refundable if cancellation is made by the deadline.
And parking is still separate there?
Yes. Self-parking is $40 per night plus tax, or $169.60 for four nights. That makes the Hyatt $2,237.64 with a car before the rental charge and fuel. Without a car, lodging remains $2,068.04.
Now Montelucia. Confirm whether the $2,018 figure was really complete.

It was complete for the room and mandatory charges. The resort-view king totals $2,018.00: $1,540.00 room, $215.60 room tax, $232.00 resort fee, and $30.40 tax on the fee. The rate requires a $504.90 deposit, equal to the first night with tax and that night’s resort fee. Cancellation is free through 6:00 p.m. Arizona time seven days before arrival. After that deadline, the full deposit is forfeited. The remaining $1,513.10 is due at the property.
That is better than a fully prepaid rate. What did you learn about the spa? We had Saturday at 2:30 in the plan.

The Saturday 2:30 p.m. 80-minute couples massage is still available and can be held while the room is booked. The treatment is $680 for two, and the spa adds a 22% service charge of $149.60, bringing it to $829.60. Any additional gratuity is optional. The spa requires a card guarantee but no advance charge. Cancellation or rescheduling is allowed until 24 hours before the appointment; inside 24 hours, the full $829.60 is charged.
The brief also mentioned Friday appointments. Are those an alternative or something already held?

They are an alternative, not an existing booking. Two individual 80-minute massages can be held Friday at 3:00 p.m. The combined treatment and service-charge total is also $829.60. The spa will keep either the Friday pair or the Saturday couples room on a courtesy hold for two hours once requested, but it will not hold both sets at once.
Keep Saturday. We arrive Thursday afternoon and I do not want the spa scheduled immediately the next day. How do the facilities compare?

All three have a pool and an on-site fitness facility. Andaz and Hyatt also list a hot tub. Montelucia currently lists heated pools and a fitness center, but the spa confirmed that its shared hot tub is closed for maintenance during these dates and gave no reopening guarantee.
For this Scottsdale trip only, do not let the unavailable hot tub eliminate Montelucia. The confirmed Saturday treatment and the better cancellation exposure matter more here.

Understood. I’ll treat that as a trip-specific exception. Montelucia still provides the pool and fitness facilities, and its Saturday spa availability distinguishes it from the lower-priced prepaid option.
Now transportation. Show me the complete trip-side comparison, including the flights we already bought, but leave meals out.

The economy rental is $286.40 including taxes for Thursday through Monday. Estimated fuel is $35. Montelucia parking is $35 nightly plus tax, totaling $148.40, so the rental-car transportation estimate is $469.80. A private round-trip airport transfer is $168 including gratuity; adding one estimated local rideshare round trip at $42 gives $210. The rideshare-only estimate remains $110. With the $556 flights and $2,018 lodging, totals before meals and spa are $3,543.80 with a rental car, $2,784 with transfers plus one local ride, or $2,684 with rideshares only. Adding the Saturday massage makes those $4,373.40, $3,613.60, and $3,513.60 respectively.
Rideshares only still makes sense. Is there any hidden resort transfer charge or breakfast inclusion at Montelucia?

No airport transfer is included, and there is no mandatory transportation charge. The resort fee already included in the $2,018 total covers listed on-property services, but breakfast is not included. There is also no breakfast credit attached to this rate.
Book Montelucia at the flexible resort-view king rate and secure the Saturday 2:30 couples massage. Use the saved card for both guarantees. Do not rent a car or arrange a transfer.

Before submission, the charges and exposure are: $504.90 charged now for the room deposit; $1,513.10 due at the resort; free room cancellation through 6:00 p.m. Arizona time seven days before arrival, then loss of the $504.90 deposit; and no spa charge now, with $829.60 due for the massage and a full-charge cancellation penalty inside 24 hours. Shall I submit both reservations on those terms?
Yes, submit both.

Montelucia is reserved for March 12-16 in a resort-view king at $2,018.00 including taxes and mandatory fees. The saved card was charged the $504.90 deposit, and $1,513.10 remains due at the resort. The room cancellation deadline is 6:00 p.m. Arizona time seven days before arrival. The 80-minute couples massage is confirmed for Saturday at 2:30 p.m. at $829.60 including the 22% service charge; the card is on file as a guarantee, with no spa charge taken now and a 24-hour cancellation deadline. No rental car, airport transfer, or other ground transportation was booked. With the previously ticketed $556 flights and the $110 rideshare estimate, the current trip total is $3,513.60 before meals.
